title: Fix typos and unclear sentences in the Session 1 notes
body:
## Problem
The Session 1 notes may contain typos or sentences that a first-year student finds confusing.

## Context
Beginners judge the whole repo by Session 1.

## Expected outcome
A clearer `sessions/session-01/README.md` and `lesson.py` comments.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/README.md`, `sessions/session-01/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] At least three improvements
- [ ] `python start.py test` still passes

## Difficulty
beginner

title: Add a log-scale option to the Session 2 app
body:
## Problem
The Arrhenius plot of Session 2 always shows log10 k; students ask to see k itself on a log axis and the natural logarithm.

## Context
Chemists use both ln k and log10 k; seeing both avoids confusion.

## Expected outcome
A switch (or second view) in the app that shows ln k, with the slope in the readout changing accordingly.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-02/app.html`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Axis labels and units are correct for both choices
- [ ] Screenshot added to the pull request

## Difficulty
beginner

title: Add Session 4: choose experiments by optimal design
body:
## Problem
The roadmap's first milestone does not exist yet.

## Context
See `promo/roadmap.md`, Session 4. Students see in Session 2 that widely spaced temperatures pin the rates down best and want a systematic method.

## Expected outcome
`sessions/session-04/` with README (sections A to F), lesson, checkpoint, exercises and app in the same style as Sessions 1 to 3.

## Relevant files
`promo/roadmap.md`, `sessions/session-03/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Checkpoint prints PASS and the roadmap checkpoint is met
- [ ] Added to the tests

## Difficulty
intermediate

title: Add Session 5: calibrating an activation energy
body:
## Problem
Session 3 calibrates only scale factors of two rate constants.

## Context
Roadmap Session 5.

## Expected outcome
A lesson and app where an activation-energy shift is fitted together with a scale factor and the correlation between them is shown.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-03/lesson.py`, `promo/roadmap.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Roadmap checkpoint met and shown
- [ ] Checkpoint added

## Difficulty
intermediate

title: Reproduce the Target: sequential assimilation with a shrinking ellipse
body:
## Problem
The Target animation shows data arriving one by one and an uncertainty ellipse that shrinks; there is no public implementation.

## Context
The code behind the Target is private on purpose. The roadmap gives the path.

## Expected outcome
Your own implementation, written from the roadmap, plus an animation like the Target.

## Relevant files
`promo/roadmap.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] One-sigma uncertainty of ln s2 non-increasing as experiments are added and below 0.06 at the end
- [ ] Short write-up of your method

## Difficulty
advanced

title: Compare the power-mean objective with weighted least squares on biased data
body:
## Problem
Session 3 shows a biased dataset moving the poorly determined parameter but compares only two objectives.

## Context
One motivation for power-mean objectives is that one dataset should not dominate a joint calibration.

## Expected outcome
A short study over many seeds and several values of p, reporting error and spread of both parameters, plus a plain-language conclusion.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-03/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] At least 20 seeds and 4 values of p
- [ ] Plots of error versus p

## Difficulty
advanced

title: Translate the Session 1 notes into Hindi
body:
## Problem
Students who prefer Hindi cannot read Session 1 comfortably.

## Context
This project teaches first- and second-year students across India; translations widen who can join.

## Expected outcome
`sessions/session-01/README.hi.md` with a faithful Hindi translation of sections A to F, linked from the main README.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/README.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] All sections translated
- [ ] Equations, code blocks and file names unchanged
- [ ] Link added to the main README

## Difficulty
beginner
